verses.text: 'Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Where has your beloved turned, That we may seek him with you?'
verses.textZh: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人往何處去了？你的良人轉向何處去了，我們好與你同去尋找他。（新娘）

verses.text: 'My beloved has gone down to his garden, To the beds of balsam, To pasture [his flock] in the gardens And gather lilies.
verses.textZh: 我的良人下入自己園中，到香花畦，在園內牧放群羊，採百合花。

verses.text: 'I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine, He who pastures [his flock] among the lilies.'
verses.textZh: 我屬我的良人，我的良人也屬我；他在百合花中牧放群羊。

verses.text: 'You are as beautiful as Tirzah, my darling, As lovely as Jerusalem, As awesome as an army with banners.
verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊，你美麗如得撒，秀美如耶路撒冷，威武如展開旌旗的軍隊。

verses.text: 'Turn your eyes away from me, For they have confused me; Your hair is like a flock of goats That have descended from Gilead.
verses.textZh: 求你掉轉眼目不看我，因你的眼目使我驚亂。你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。

verses.text: 'Your teeth are like a flock of ewes Which have come up from [their] washing, All of which bear twins, And not one among them has lost her young.
verses.textZh: 你的牙齒如一群母羊洗淨上來，個個都有雙生，沒有一隻喪掉子的。

verses.text: 'Your temples are like a slice of a pomegranate Behind your veil.
verses.textZh: 你的兩太陽在帕子內，如同一塊石榴。

verses.text: 'There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, And maidens without number;
verses.textZh: 有六十王后八十妃嬪，並有無數的童女。

verses.text: [But] my dove, my perfect one, is unique: She is her mother's only [daughter]; She is the pure [child] of the one who bore her. The maidens saw her and called her blessed, The queens and the concubines [also], and they praised her, [saying],
verses.textZh: 我的鴿子，我的完全人，只有這一個是他母親獨生的，是生養他者所寶愛的。眾女子見了就稱他有福；王后妃嬪見了也讚美他。

verses.text: 'Who is this that grows like the dawn, As beautiful as the full moon, As pure as the sun, As awesome as an army with banners?'
verses.textZh: 那向外觀看、如晨光發現、美麗如月亮、皎潔如日頭、威武如展開旌旗軍隊的是誰呢？

verses.text: 'I went down to the orchard of nut trees To see the blossoms of the valley, To see whether the vine had budded [Or] the pomegranates had bloomed.
verses.textZh: 我下入核桃園，要看谷中青綠的植物，要看葡萄發芽沒有，石榴開花沒有。

verses.text: 'Before I was aware, my soul set me [Over] the chariots of my noble people.'
verses.textZh: 不知不覺，我的心將我安置在我尊長的車中。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）

verses.text: 'Come back, come back, O Shulammite; Come back, come back, that we may gaze at you!' 'Why should you gaze at the Shulammite, As at the dance of the two companies?
verses.textZh: 回來，回來，書拉密女；你回來，你回來，使我們得觀看你。（新娘）你們為何要觀看書拉密女，像觀看瑪哈念跳舞的呢？
